optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the backtest harness and holdout sets for demand-forecast models, ensuring version control with the forecasting team.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the backtest harness that replays twelve months of supplier order history per pilot customer and the holdout sets frozen per quarter, both under version control with the forecasting team.

professionalSummary.text: Publishes evaluation reports with per-customer error tables after running pre-release backtests for model versions.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-release backtest for the three model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report with per-customer error tables.

professionalSummary.text: Improved forecast accuracy on pilot customers by reducing weighted forecast error from 24.5% to 17.8% against the documented baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: Weighted forecast error on the four pilot customers fell from 24.5 percent to 17.8 percent between version 1.4 and version 2.0, on the frozen Q3 holdout set and against the documented version 1.4 baseline of 24.5 percent.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates release decisions with forecasting and customer operations teams, documenting responsibility boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated release decisions in the forecasting release meeting; the forecasting lead took the release decision and customer operations confirmed the rollout to each pilot customer.

professionalSummary.text: Documents backtest assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions for each model version.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the backtest notes for each version, listing the holdout composition, the known limitation that promotional periods were excluded from the holdout, and the hand-over items for the next backtest.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained version-controlled backtest harness and holdout sets for four pilot customers, replaying twelve months of supplier order history.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the backtest harness that replays twelve months of supplier order history per pilot customer and the holdout sets frozen per quarter, both under version control with the forecasting team.

experienceHighlights.text: Published evaluation reports with per-customer error tables for three model versions released in the year.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release backtest for the three model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report with per-customer error tables.

experienceHighlights.text: Achieved 27.3% improvement in forecast accuracy (24.5% to 17.8% weighted error) on four pilot customers against documented baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Weighted forecast error on the four pilot customers fell from 24.5 percent to 17.8 percent between version 1.4 and version 2.0, on the frozen Q3 holdout set and against the documented version 1.4 baseline of 24.5 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented holdout composition, promotional exclusion limitation, and hand-over items in backtest notes for each version.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the backtest notes for each version, listing the holdout composition, the known limitation that promotional periods were excluded from the holdout, and the hand-over items for the next backtest.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Per-version evaluation report with weighted error metrics, baseline line, and version markers; backtest notes for version 2.0 with harness run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the per-version evaluation report (weighted error per pilot customer, baseline line, version markers) and the backtest notes for version 2.0, with the harness run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.witness: Maintained the backtest harness that replays twelve months of supplier order history per pilot customer and the holdout sets frozen per quarter, both under version control with the forecasting team.

skills.witness: Wrote the backtest notes for each version, listing the holdout composition, the known limitation that promotional periods were excluded from the holdout, and the hand-over items for the next backtest.
